summary: Onboarding request: field-level provenance manifest and end-to-end delivery certificates for SIEM ingest
description:
Issue summary:
FinCore is onboarding to Redwood's live SIEM export and requires a field-level provenance manifest plus cryptographic delivery certificates for each daily and on-demand delivery. They want a concrete sample bundle that includes (1) canonical field mapping (source_field -> redwood_field -> data-type), (2) per-batch signed checksum and timestamp, (3) replay/resume token examples, and (4) a human-readable provenance manifest describing transformations and redaction applied.

Impact:
- FinCore will not complete production cutover until they receive a verifiable manifest and delivery certificates.
- This blocks their compliance review and transaction monitoring team for an estimated 3 business days.

Environment:
- Customer account: fincore-prod-034
- Export target: SFTP to customer-owned bucket (sftp.fincore-bank.com) using user-key auth
- Redwood delivery pipeline: audit-export-v2 -> per-tenant-envelope -> sftp-adapter

Customer asks / Acceptance criteria:
1) A sample evidence bundle for a 24-hour slice with: per-file SHA256 checksum, RFC3161 timestamp, and signature metadata (key-id).
2) Field provenance manifest that documents: transformation steps (pseudonymization rules), redaction reasons, timezone canonicalization (UTC), and canonical event ID derivation.
3) Delivery certificate (human-readable) that states delivery window, file naming convention, and resume token format.
4) Minimal reproduction instructions for FinCore's SOC to verify checksums and timestamps locally.

Steps to reproduce (for support/testing):
1) Generate a 1-day export from staging tenant fincore-staging-01 using audit-export-v2 with full-raw flag enabled.
2) Route to our test sftp endpoint and capture the output bundle.
3) Run checksum/signing script (provided) to generate a signed manifest.
4) Validate resume token by replaying with the same token into a sandboxed ingest.

Logs / Evidence provided by customer:
- Example filename: fincore-2026-03-10-utc-archive.tar.gz
- Provided sample checksum: SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924...
- SFTP server logs (customer-provided) showing accepted connection from redwood-exporter-12

Notes:
- Customer requests HSM-backed signing example if possible, otherwise an emulated signed manifest with key rotation metadata is acceptable for now.
- They flagged timezone-normalization as high risk: their downstream SIEM expects UTC event_time.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Run export from fincore-staging-01 with full-raw. 2) Send to test SFTP. 3) Use provided signing script to produce manifest. 4) Replay with resume token into sandbox ingest.
comments: 2026-03-12 09:21 - Maya Patel: Opening ticket on behalf of FinCore SOC. They've attached SFTP logs and a compliance checklist. Asked for sample bundle by COB 2026-03-16.
2026-03-12 11:05 - Sophie Chen: Acknowledged. Assigning to export team for sample bundle generation. Need to confirm signing approach (HSM vs ephemeral key).

2026-03-12 14:30 - Export Eng (Liam O'Connor): Investigating. Staging export pipeline can produce the raw bundle. For HSM signing we need enterprise key provisioning; recommend emulated signature with key-id metadata for initial delivery.

2026-03-13 08:47 - Sophie Chen: Shared preliminary sample bundle and manifest with FinCore. Marked as 'Waiting on Customer' for verification. Included md5/sha256, RFC3161 timestamp reference, and key rotation note.

2026-03-13 12:10 - FinCore SOC (Elena V.): Verified checksums and timestamps locally; requested clear example of resume token structure and a short verification script they can run as part of their intake pipeline.
investigation_notes: Export pipeline: audit-export-v2 verified to produce UTC-normalized event_time when timezone-normalization flag set. Confirmed by running one-day job in staging.
Signing: HSM not provisioned for this tenant. Generated emulated ECDSA signature using dev key; included key-id: redwood-demo-key-2026. Documented rotation cadence and verification steps.
Resume tokens: tokens are opaque base64 of (tenant_id|sequence_start|checksum). Need to provide decoding helper and canonical format to customer.
resolution_notes: 2026-03-13 16:02 - Resolution: Delivered sample evidence bundle to FinCore SFTP test endpoint. Bundle included: tar.gz with event files, signed manifest (RFC3161 timestamp + ECDSA signature), per-file SHA256 checksums, and README with verification commands.
Provided a small Python script (sha256 verification + RFC3161 timestamp check + resume token helper) in the ticket attachment and linked Confluence playbook.
Follow-up: Create a task to offer HSM-signed delivery for enterprise onboarding (backlog: INT-4120).
customer_response: 2026-03-13 17:10 - FinCore SOC (Elena V.): Received sample and verification script. Able to validate checksums and timestamping. Accepts emulated signing for initial onboarding; will raise HSM requirement as a contract amendment if needed.
